text: My daily routine is built around consistency, which helps me stay productive. I wake up at six thirty each morning, and my first habits involve stretching and drinking a large glass of water. After a quick breakfast, I start my work schedule at nine, focusing on tasks in two-hour blocks with short breaks in between. For exercise, I usually go for a thirty-minute run right after work. In the evening, I prepare a simple dinner and spend time reading or watching a documentary. By ten thirty, I’m in bed. Following this same pattern every day keeps my energy steady and my mind clear.
